candidates.description: Normal 12-lead electrocardiogram without rhythm, conduction, or morphological abnormalities.
Supraventricular tachyarrhythmia characterized by uncoordinated atrial activation with irregular ventricular response.
Conduction block in the right bundle branch resulting in delayed activation of the right ventricle (QRS duration >= 120 ms, rsR' in V1).
Conduction block in the left bundle branch resulting in delayed activation of the left ventricle (QRS duration >= 120 ms, broad R in I/V6).
Sinus rhythm with resting ventricular rate < 60 beats per minute.
Sinus rhythm with resting ventricular rate > 100 beats per minute.
Delayed atrioventricular conduction characterized by persistent PR interval prolongation > 200 ms with 1:1 AV conduction.
Myocardial necrosis / acute injury manifest by localized ST-segment elevation (>= 1 mm in >= 2 contiguous leads) or pathological Q waves.

path_invariance_contract.retrieval_filtering_policy: STRICTLY PROHIBITED. Clinical Knowledge Pathways (CKP) must NEVER reduce, filter, or re-rank candidate classes prior to reasoning. Both Control and CKP paths evaluate the identical 8 candidate classes.

classification_modality.independent_scoring: Each candidate is evaluated independently; supporting one diagnosis does not preclude concurrent co-occurring diagnoses.
